g.text: Title: Controller board: link to the shack and PTT

g.desc: Title: Controller board: link to the shack and PTT

g.text: ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2 (D-55), RJ45 LINK 4 opto current loops (D-56, D-57)

g.desc: ESP32-C3-DevKit-RUST-2 (D-55), RJ45 LINK 4 opto current loops (D-56, D-57)

g.text: J2 2x12 to RF board J14 (D-51, D-52). PTT to K0 in hardware (no MCU)

g.desc: J2 2x12 to RF board J14 (D-51, D-52). PTT to K0 in hardware (no MCU)

g.text: Stackup and size: to decide with the layout

g.desc: Stackup and size: to decide with the layout

fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Link to the shack (D-56, D-57): Cat6 #1 UTP, four opto current loops, 10 mA each, powered from the shack (12 V, about 820R there).

g.desc: Link to the shack (D-56, D-57): Cat6 #1 UTP, four opto current loops, 10 mA each, powered from the shack (12 V, about 820R there).

g.text: T568B pairs, + wire first: pair 1 = pins 4/5 data in, pair 2 = 1/2 PTT, pair 3 = 3/6 KILL, pair 4 = 7/8 data out.

g.desc: T568B pairs, + wire first: pair 1 = pins 4/5 data in, pair 2 = 1/2 PTT, pair 3 = 3/6 KILL, pair 4 = 7/8 data out.

g.text: Entry per pair: GDT to CHASSIS (box earth), 47R MELF per wire, SMBJ15CA across the pair; then the opto.

g.desc: Entry per pair: GDT to CHASSIS (box earth), 47R MELF per wire, SMBJ15CA across the pair; then the opto.

g.text: Receive: loop current = LED on = output low. DATA_RX idle (mark) is low: the UART RX is inverted in firmware (ESP32-C3 line inverse).

g.desc: Receive: loop current = LED on = output low. DATA_RX idle (mark) is low: the UART RX is inverted in firmware (ESP32-C3 line inverse).

g.text: PTT: FT-710 TX GND closes loop 2; PTT_N low; U5 gives TX_ANY and the K0 drives, in hardware, not through the MCU.

g.desc: PTT: FT-710 TX GND closes loop 2; PTT_N low; U5 gives TX_ANY and the K0 drives, in hardware, not through the MCU.

g.text: KILL: loop 3 closed through the shack KILL switch; open loop, cut cable or no shack supply = KILL high (to the safety gate).

g.desc: KILL: loop 3 closed through the shack KILL switch; open loop, cut cable or no shack supply = KILL high (to the safety gate).

g.text: Transmit: DATA_TX high (UART idle) = LED on = loop closed; MCU off = loop open, so the shack sees a break. 9600 baud (C-18).

g.desc: Transmit: DATA_TX high (UART idle) = LED on = loop closed; MCU off = loop open, so the shack sees a break. 9600 baud (C-18).
